project.method: Creative Strategy -> Art Direction -> Visual Scene Spec -> Validation Image -> HTML/Motion
project.human_feedback_trigger: v2 improved architecture but looked too simple/template-like for a premium custom LP

truth.name: 株式会社清松
truth.license: 兵庫県知事許可 第215042号

creative_strategy.primary_promise: 景観をつくる。地面から、暮らしまで整える。
creative_strategy.positioning: 造園単体ではなく、造園・土木・とび土工・解体まで扱う地域の現場会社としての信頼感
anti_template: 均一なカードグリッドを連続させない
各sectionを同じ白背景・同じ余白で流さない
Heroで汎用的な中央寄せコピーを使わない
造園=葉っぱ装飾という短絡を避ける
すべての写真を角丸カードに入れない

visual_direction.name: TERRAIN / CRAFT EDITORIAL
visual_direction.one_sentence: 地層・石組・現場の線を編集グラフィックへ変換し、静かな造園写真と土木の力強さを一つの誌面体験にする。
design_principles: topographic contour lines as structural graphics
full-bleed photography interrupted by hard editorial cuts
contrast between quiet ivory paper and near-black green fields
proof data treated as technical annotation, not cards
section rhythm alternates immersive / sparse / technical / immersive

geometry.hero_boundary: diagonal/topographic cut with one large concave bend
geometry.section_rule: each major scene has unique silhouette; no repeated rounded-card container system
geometry.proof_lines: hairline rules + datum marks + coordinate-like labels

craft: micro parallax between foreground and text

scenes.marketing_job: 会社の空気感と対応の広さを一撃で理解させる
scenes.composition: full-bleed garden/worksite photo, oversized left-bottom serif headline, vertical SEISHO wordmark, technical proof strip crossing lower third
scenes.headline:
景観をつくる。
地面から、暮らしまで整える。
scenes.subcopy: 兵庫県尼崎市。造園・土木・とび土工・解体まで。

scenes.marketing_job: 公開確認できる会社情報を設計図の注釈のように見せる
scenes.composition: large negative-space field + offset technical ledger + one oversized numeric/license fragment

scenes.marketing_job: 4業務を別々のカードで並べず、地面から上物までの仕事の連続性として見せる
scenes.composition: four horizontal field bands with alternating media/text orientation and large 01-04 numerals

scenes.marketing_job: 造園と土木が共存する会社らしい素材感・手仕事・現場感を強く印象づける
scenes.composition: dark immersive spread, irregular collage, stone/craft/civil crops, contour-line overlay, minimal copy
scenes.headline:
植える。組む。掘る。
現場の輪郭を、最後まで。

scenes.marketing_job: 営業サンプルとしての提案価値を説明しつつテンプレ感を出さない
scenes.composition: three editorial statements placed on one continuous sheet, connected by a thin groundline rather than cards

scenes.marketing_job: 身元情報を解決して問い合わせへ
scenes.composition: near-black contact field, giant phone numerals, company ledger inset as paper slip, vertical address annotation

responsive.tablet: preserve asymmetry using 8-col grid; avoid plain stacking where possible
responsive.mobile: recompose typography and media order; vertical wordmark becomes horizontal; scope bands remain distinct; CTA becomes fixed-width full button
responsive.hard_gate: mobile must remain designed, not merely stacked desktop

validation_rules.premium_bar: must look custom art-directed and screenshot-worthy, not clean-template premium
